items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And Scarett and some baritone, guy used to play baritone (unintelligible) on our lunch hour

ctx.x: And Scarett and some baritone, guy used to play baritone (unintelligible) on our lunch hour, on intermission, and he all of a sudden just get high all the time, you know, big fellow, played baritone and alto. So when he come back to play the baritone, a lot of go way up and down like a fountain, everybody in the band sitting down and sitting in the cabaret, started laughing, say, how'd the water come from?
